title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_6911)
clause_1_scope: Amendment to IS IS_6911 (Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_6911)): AMENDMENT NO. 1 AUGUST 2017 TO STAINLESS STEEL PLATE, SHEET AND STRIP — SPECIFICATION (Page 3, Table 1) — Substitute the following for the existing table: See Table 1 on page 2. (Second Revision) [Page 6, Table 3, SI No. (1) (3), col 2] — Substitute *X02Cr12TY' for *X02Cr12TINb.* [Page 6, Table 3, SI No. (1) (5), col 2)] — Substitute *X02Cr12' for ‘X02Cr12Ni.’ [Page 6, Table 3, SI No. (iti) (12)] — Insert the following new entry and renumber the subsequent serial numbers: SI No. Grade Designation Symbols'| Annealing or | Quenching | Symbols? | Hardening | Quenching | Tempering Softening Media

clause_2_normative_references.title: Code for designation of steels, Part I Based on lettter symbols

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
